pins.definition: A flexible container made of plastic, paper, or cloth used for carrying or holding things.
A container made of cloth, leather, or plastic used for carrying items.

subject: a cloth bag
brief: A bright canvas shopping bag sits wide open on a wooden market stall, overflowing with round red tomatoes and green leafy vegetables, its sturdy handles resting against the side.
prompt: A bright canvas shopping bag sits wide open on a wooden market stall, overflowing with round red tomatoes and green leafy vegetables, its sturdy handles resting against the side. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.
